object_description: two structures, a simple cubic sports hall and a three-tiered split-level school building
geometry_property: raw-sawn spruce boards and metal sheets
design_condition: the cubic hall takes its position from one neighbouring settlement while the school building orients itself to another and to the existing lawn geometry, so the setting keeps the area pleasantly permeable

positive: The cubic hall is based on the neighbouring settlement in its position
The school building is oriented towards another building structure and to the geometry of the existing lawn
Setting the two volumes ensures a pleasant permeability of the area
The path connection between the two neighbourhoods will be strengthened
The break area on the south side with groups of trees looks inviting and allows a wide variety of uses
The planting garden is well placed
The school building is very nicely organised inside
The split-level system generates a generous, naturally lit access area
It divides the class groups into an appropriate size
This spatial constellation is particularly welcomed by the school
Accommodating school building and hall in two volumes brings great structural advantages
It gives urban potential to be integrated into the landscape using simple means
The economic targets were just met and the sustainability targets were within reach
negative: The parts relate strongly to adjacent buildings but neglect their own relationship
Hall and school remain volumetrically alien to each other despite the same materiality
They cannot enter an appropriate dialogue despite their spatial proximity
This is particularly unpleasant in the access situation along the fenced hard space
Delivering the kitchen via the break area is problematic
The development of the planting garden is missing
The raw-sawn boards and metal sheets seem modest for an urban house with public character
Access to the classrooms is rather tight
The additional level shift of individual rooms seems strained despite the exciting views
The narrow basement corridor without daylight appears less confident in its length and darkness
School use in front of the gymnasium cloakrooms is an awkward solution expressing lack of space
The relatively uncompact building volume exceeds the ecological targets
The arrangement and relationship between the two volumes remain incomprehensible
This severely weakens the great quality of the interior organisation
